title: Recovery grant for Small Business and Non-Profit Organisations, East Coast Severe Weather and Tropical Cyclone Alfred Severe Weather – Privacy collection notice
summary: This notice explains how Service NSW collects and uses your personal information when you apply for the Small Business Recovery Grant.
what_you_need: Proof of identity document (e.g., driver's licence or Australian passport)
Additional documentation and evidence required in the Program Guidelines

more_info.text: you can access and seek correction of the information
privacy enquiries or complaints can be made.
Read the Service NSW privacy statement for more information on how:
You can call Service NSW on 13 77 88.
Service NSW is located at 2-24 Rawson Place Sydney NSW 2000.

internal_links.text: Recovery Grant for Small Businesses and Non-Profit Organisations

faqs.q: Why is Service NSW collecting my personal information?
faqs.a: Information is collected to process your application, determine your eligibility for the Grant, provide you with further information about the Grant, and pay the Grant to eligible applicants, among other related purposes.

faqs.q: What types of personal information do I need to provide?
faqs.a: You may need to provide your name, date of birth, email address, phone number, details from a proof of identity document (like a driver's licence or Australian passport), a valid ABN/ACN, banking details, and additional documentation to prove eligibility.

faqs.q: How will my information be used and disclosed?
faqs.a: Your information may be used to contact you about your application, process payments, invite you to participate in voluntary evaluation, identify future government support grants you may be eligible for, and conduct audits or investigations.
